--- alter_sequence_if_exists.sql
ALTER SEQUENCE IF EXISTS seq SET OPTIONS (start_with_counter = 1)

--- AST
&ast.AlterSequence{
  IfExists: true,
  Name:     &ast.Path{
    Idents: []*ast.Ident{
      &ast.Ident{
        NamePos: 25,
        NameEnd: 28,
        Name:    "seq",
      },
    },
  },
  Options: &ast.Options{
    Options: 33,
    Rparen:  64,
    Records: []*ast.OptionsDef{
      &ast.OptionsDef{
        Name: &ast.Ident{
          NamePos: 42,
          NameEnd: 60,
          Name:    "start_with_counter",
        },
        Value: &ast.IntLiteral{
          ValuePos: 63,
          ValueEnd: 64,
          Base:     10,
          Value:    "1",
        },
      },
    },
  },
}

--- SQL
ALTER SEQUENCE IF EXISTS seq SET OPTIONS (start_with_counter = 1)
